title: Viva Insights: Access Management for Copilot Analytics roles and permissions
summary: Hold: automatic migration is documented, but the new control's default enforcement state is not. The licensing paragraph extends a Copilot Dashboard entitlement to Copilot Analytics as a whole, and the recommended role-export operation is not documented at the location given.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an in-product Access Management experience for Viva Insights - Copilot Analytics.
claims.quote: Admins can now manage who has access to Viva Insights - Copilot Analytics, and what they can do, directly in the product.

claims.claim: Global administrators can manage access through the planned experience.
claims.quote: The new Access Management experience brings role assignment and permissions into one place for Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators

claims.claim: AI administrators can manage access through the planned experience.
claims.quote: The new Access Management experience brings role assignment and permissions into one place for Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators

claims.claim: Viva Insights administrators can manage access through the planned experience.
claims.quote: The new Access Management experience brings role assignment and permissions into one place for Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators

claims.claim: The roadmap plans to consolidate access management currently performed through VFAM in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: instead of managing access across Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center and in-product Manager Settings.

claims.quote: instead of managing access across Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center and in-product Manager Settings.

claims.claim: The new Access Management control starts enforcing by default, represented by defaultState on.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics Access Management default enforcement existing VFAM policies migration. Read roadmap, Manage settings, Identification, and Business Analytics access; automatic migration is stated, but the new control's default enforcement is not.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to unknown. Add: 'Microsoft has not stated the new control's default enforcement state; the roadmap separately says existing role assignments continue to work and users are moved automatically to system-defined access policies.' Keep the documented automatic-migration statements.

claims.claim: The included licensing model describes a new option inside Copilot Analytics under existing product licensing, with no separately published Access Management entitlement.
claims.quote: The Copilot Dashboard is available in the Viva Insights web app for any customer with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 subscription for business or enterprise, who has an active Exchange Online account.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Copilot Analytics as a whole is available with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 business or enterprise subscription and Exchange Online.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics licensing access management new experience price prerequisites. Read Copilot Analytics introduction and Environment requirements excerpt; the cited subscription entitlement explicitly describes the Copilot Dashboard, not all Copilot Analytics.
claims.fix: Replace the entitlement sentence in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with: 'The Copilot Analytics introduction says the Copilot Dashboard is available in the Viva Insights web app with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 business or enterprise subscription and an active Exchange Online account; its features and metrics depend on assigned Copilot and Viva Insights licences.' In the cost rationale, replace 'Copilot Analytics, which comes with Microsoft 365 or Office 365 business and enterprise subscriptions' with 'Copilot Analytics; the introduction publishes a subscription entitlement for the Copilot Dashboard, not the entire analytics suite'.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Dashboard feature and metric availability depends on assigned Copilot and Viva Insights licences.
claims.quote: The dashboard's availability of features and metrics, however, depend on the number of assigned Copilot and Viva Insights licenses.

claims.claim: Insights Administrator and Insights Analyst roles currently determine access to Viva Insights product areas.
claims.quote: Each role only gives access to actions, pages, reports, and data that correspond with that role. Roles are assigned independently, are non-cumulative, and don't roll up.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; controls[2].governs
claims.claim: VFAM policies enable or disable features for users and groups, including Viva Insights features.
claims.quote: This example adds a policy for the Reflection feature in Viva Insights. The policy disables the feature for the specified users and group members.

claims.claim: Manager settings determine manager access to team-scoped analytics.
claims.quote: you can set up and edit Manager settings to allow all measured people managers or a specified group of managers to access aggregated insights about their team

claims.where: Risk assessment; Why it matters; controls[4].governs
claims.claim: Partitions control which employee rows, attribute columns and datasets analysts can query.
claims.quote: A partition is both a row-level and a column-level control for data access. ... Select which dataset to include in the partition, such as Glint survey data. All filters and attributes you selected in the previous steps apply to this dataset.

claims.claim: Global Administrators automatically inherit Insights Administrator privileges.
claims.quote: Users with the Microsoft 365 Global Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID automatically inherit Insights Administrator privileges.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Only Global Administrators or AI Administrators can manage today's identification access policies in Copilot Analytics.
claims.quote: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or an AI Administrator can create and manage identification access policies. Either role can perform every step, in both the Microsoft 365 admin center and PowerShell.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether Viva Insights administrators can grant identification or export in the planned Copilot Analytics experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics Access management permission sets; Copilot Analytics Access Management PowerShell Graph permission sets licensing. Read Identification and Business Analytics access; the latter grants capabilities in a different app, not the planned Copilot Analytics experience.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the mapping of existing VFAM policies into the planned access policies or their conflict precedence.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics Access Management default enforcement existing VFAM policies migration. Read roadmap, Business Analytics access, Manage settings, and VFAM precedence excerpt; existing-role migration and VFAM-only precedence do not specify this mapping or cross-model precedence.

claims.claim: The cited Business Analytics Access management feature belongs to the Frontier preview program.
claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program.

claims.claim: Business Analytics tenants start with Chief Officer, Group Manager and Analyst permission sets.
claims.quote: Every tenant starts with the following system-defined items. ... Three permission sets: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst.

claims.claim: Business Analytics starts with three corresponding access policies pairing their permission sets with the Global partition.
claims.quote: Three access policies: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst. Each system-defined policy pairs the permission set of the same name with the Global partition.

claims.claim: The Business Analytics Global partition is read-only.
claims.quote: No. The Global partition is read-only and can't be deleted.

claims.claim: Business Analytics effective access combines all valid assignments.
claims.quote: the user's effective access is the combination of all of their valid assignments. A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.claim: Business Analytics permission sets include export and identification capabilities.
claims.quote: Capability settings, such as export, identification, report customization, and report publishing

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center path Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add enables individual web app access.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... select Users. ... select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: The existing Viva Insights web app is on by default.
claims.quote: The Viva Insights web app is on by default.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator can manage the Viva Insights web app control.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level

claims.claim: The existing web app control supports tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level

claims.claim: Turning off the web app control disables the whole app, including Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis and admin tools.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator has no automatic web app access and must add themselves.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center path Settings > Viva > Viva Insights > Add-on Plan > role > Add users is a documented route to assigning Insights roles.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Under Add-on Plan, select the role you want to assign: Insights Admin or Insights Analyst. ... Select Add users or Add groups.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments creates Microsoft Entra role assignments.
claims.quote:
Use the Create unifiedRoleAssignment API to assign the role.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments

claims.claim: The role-assignment request body identifies the role with roleDefinitionId and the assignee with principalId.
claims.quote:
"principalId": "<Object ID of user or group>",
"roleDefinitionId": "<ID of role definition>",
"directoryScopeId": "/"

claims.claim: The documented Microsoft 365 admin center role-assignment steps require a Global Administrator.
claims.quote: These steps must be performed by the Microsoft 365 Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Organisations using PIM can assign Insights roles in Microsoft Entra PIM instead of the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: If your organization uses PIM, you might choose to assign roles in Microsoft Entra PIM rather than the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy reaches the VFAM policy form in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: Extend controls[2].ui.path to 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting'. Keep the note that the app and feature are selected in the form.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <featureID> -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the specified feature.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false -GroupIds group1@contoso.com,group2@contoso.com -UserIds user1@contoso.com,user2@contoso.com ... use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights lists supported Viva Insights features and their IDs.
claims.quote: Use the Get-VivaModuleFeature PowerShell cmdlet to get a list of all of the features available in a specific Microsoft 365 app and their associated IDs. ... Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy retrieves existing VFAM policies.
claims.quote: start by getting the specific UID for the access policy - you can get that by running Get-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy.

claims.claim: Settings > Manager Settings > Use AAD groups > Add group is documented in the Viva Insights Admin portal.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Viva Insights Admin portal with your admin credentials. ... select Settings, and then Manager Settings. ... Select Use AAD groups. ... Select Add group.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation for configuring Viva Insights Manager settings was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Manager settings Graph PowerShell; Viva Insights partitions API Graph. Read Configure manager settings, Manage settings, and search excerpts for Graph workplace intelligence and personal-insights cmdlets; none documents changing these Manager settings.

claims.claim: Viva Insights Administrators and AI admins can configure Manager settings.
claims.quote: Applies to: Viva Insights Administrator, AI admin

claims.claim: Manager settings changes apply after one hour.
claims.quote: Changes to these settings will apply after one hour.

claims.claim: Settings > Partitions > Create new partition reaches partition creation in the Viva Insights web app admin experience.
claims.quote: In the Viva Insights web app's admin experience, select Partitions under Settings. ... Select Create new partition. ... Under Partition setup: ... Filter which employee data ... Add employee attributes. ... Pick which analysts ... Select which dataset
claims.fix: Extend controls[4].ui.path to 'Settings > Partitions > Create new partition > Partition setup'. Append to its note: 'In the form, filter employee data, add attributes, assign analysts and select the dataset.' The existing Insights Administrator role statement is supported.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation for configuring Viva Insights partitions was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights partitions API Graph; Viva Insights Copilot Analytics Access Management permission sets access policies licensing prerequisites PowerShell Graph partitions manager settings. Read Partitions and Business Analytics access; connector and Graph excerpts expose data, not partition setters.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has not documented the new Copilot Analytics Access Management control's UI or automation.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics Access management permission sets; Copilot Analytics Access Management PowerShell Graph permission sets licensing. claims.claim: VFAM permits at most 10 user/group policies per feature.
claims.quote: You can assign a maximum of 10 policies per feature to users and groups.

claims.claim: Each VFAM user/group policy supports at most 20 users or groups.
claims.quote: Each policy can be assigned to a maximum of 20 users or groups.

claims.claim: VFAM permits one additional tenant-wide policy per feature.
claims.quote: You can assign one additional policy per feature to the entire tenant by using the -Everyone parameter

claims.claim: VFAM changes for the Viva Insights controls described take effect within 24 hours.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature. Changes for Copilot in Viva Engage might take up to 48 hours.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview contains VFAM change logs covering policy creation, updates and deletions.
claims.quote: For a history of policy creation, updates, and deletions, see the Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) change logs for your organization in Microsoft Purview.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: Current Insights role assignments can be exported from Viva Insights > Add-on Plan in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Insights Administrator Analyst export role assignments Microsoft 365 admin center Add-on Plan; Viva Insights export role assignments. Read Assign roles and export search excerpts; Add-on Plan documents assignment and verification, not an export operation.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with: 'Record the current Insights Administrator and Insights Analyst assignments from Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Viva > Viva Insights > Add-on Plan > role so you can compare them with the migrated policies.' This verification route is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/assign-user-roles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, first bullet
claims.claim: A permissive permission-set/partition pairing in the planned Copilot Analytics experience provides employee-level Copilot data access in one step.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics Access management permission sets; Copilot Analytics Access Management PowerShell Graph permission sets licensing. Read roadmap and Business Analytics access; employee-level identification/export capabilities are documented for the latter app, not this planned experience.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: 'A policy pairs a permission set with a partition, so review both what users can do and which population and datasets they can see.' Keep the separately supported sentence about today's partitions.

claims.claim: The roadmap specifies that the automatic migration happens only once.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics Access Management default enforcement existing VFAM policies migration. Read roadmap and Business Analytics access; both describe automatic transition, neither specifies that assignments or migration run only once.
claims.fix: Replace 'a one-time migration described by the roadmap' with 'an automatic migration described by the roadmap'.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; controls table
claims.claim: The checklist's instruction to review VFAM change logs has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Review the VFAM change logs in Microsoft Purview for policy changes made around the migration.' The six controls rows cover web app access, roles, VFAM feature policies, Manager settings, partitions and the new experience; none covers audit-log review.
claims.fix: Remove the After rollout bullet instructing the reader to review VFAM change logs; that checklist step has no matching controls row. Do not add a new row in this correction.
